disposition_reason: Mechanistic study of uranyl nitrate binding to proteins and inhibition of glucose metabolism in yeast and bacteria; no occurrence data.

study.origin: United States, Argonne National Laboratory and University of Chicago

non_numeric_findings: Glucose fermentation and oxidation in yeast inhibited by 7.7 micrograms uranium per mg dry weight (p. 178).
Inhibition released by phosphate, ATP or citrate at pH 7.3; interpreted as binding to cell-membrane proteins.
